# CVArchitect

> Autonomous AI Resume Agent Platform. Tailor your resume to any job in seconds without hallucinating experience or stuffing keywords.

CVArchitect (https://cvarchitect.app) is an agentic resume architecture platform. Unlike traditional static template builders, CVArchitect operates an autonomous agent loop that analyzes job descriptions, verifies authentic candidate experience, frames metrics in Google XYZ format, and simulates ATS scoring (Workday, Greenhouse, Lever, Taleo).

## Key Capabilities & Systems

- **Autonomous Resume Agent**: Paste any job description. The agent extracts seniority signals, core competencies, and keyword requirements, then rewrites bullets with strict zero-hallucination guardrails.
- **Grounded Evidence Engine**: Every bullet rewrite traces to authentic user history. The engine verifies projects, roles, and metrics before editing—blocking invented claims, inflated titles, or keyword stuffing.
- **Google XYZ Impact Bullet Optimizer**: Automatically reframes passive job descriptions into measurable business achievements ("Accomplished [X] as measured by [Y], by doing [Z]").
- **ATS Match Scorecard & Simulation**: Real-time compatibility rating (0–100%) scored against the exact parsing rules of Workday, Taleo, Lever, and Greenhouse.
- **Interactive Drag & Drop Resume Studio**: 10+ ATS-tuned typographic templates (Harvard Classic, Executive Pro, Vanguard, Modern Minimalist, Tech Developer, Student Fresh Grad) with pixel-perfect PDF and editable DOCX export.
- **Tailored Cover Letter Generator**: Generates concise, role-specific cover letters aligned with the company's stated mission and requirements in under 30 seconds.
- **Interview Intelligence**: Synthesizes likely STAR-method behavioural and technical interview questions grounded in the tailored resume and target job posting.

## Pricing & Access Tiers

- **Foundation Free Tier**: 1 fully tailored AI resume on base ATS templates with complete download. No credit card required.
- **Career Build ($10/month)**: Continuous unlimited tailoring, all templates, saved resume versions, cover letter generator, and unlimited PDF/DOCX exports. Cancel anytime.
- **Lifetime Pass ($99 one-time)**: Permanent unlimited access to all current and future agent models, templates, and tailoring.
